description: Traffic Violations is a dataset listed in Montgomery County open data portal (data.montgomerycountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Montgomery County. This dataset contains traffic violation information from all electronic traffic violations issued in the County. Any information that can be used to uniquely identify the vehicle, the vehicle owner or the officer issuing the violation will not be published. Update Frequency: Daily. Coverage: Montgomery County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Public Safety. Its tags are electronic issued, stop, traffic, vehicle, accident. The table has 54 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-montgomerycountymd-gov-portal.
